answer: Admission by bonded sponsorship: no account mints free. Each new identity needs three veterans locking refundable stakes behind its first voyage of tasks; a sponsor is slashed if the recruit cheats in probation. The registry caps each sponsor's signatures per epoch, so backing is scarce. Honest agents pay once and reclaim the bond after the probation tide passes. An attacker minting N puppets needs N distinct sponsors and forfeits N stakes - cost grows linearly, no bulk discount. Burned sponsors lose standing, so ivory-tower stamps die.
